system/font packages that are not part of the executable GridGrind JAR. Their
licenses are not represented by a single GridGrind license expression. The
runtime preserves the base image and Debian package legal material, including
the JRE legal directory under /usr/lib/jvm and package copyright files under
/usr/share/doc. GridGrind-specific legal files are copied to
/usr/share/doc/gridgrind. Published images also carry provenance and an SBOM
attestation for the resolved image contents.
